key: RINGMASTER: Wait, come back--
en: RINGMASTER: Wait, come back--
ja: リングマスター: 待って、戻ってきて――

key: Ugh!
en: Ugh!
ja: うぐっ!

key: RINGMASTER: Finally...
en: RINGMASTER: Finally...
ja: リングマスター: やっと……

key: Now listen here, you... whatever you are!
en: Now listen here, you... whatever you are!
ja: いいこと、聞きなさい、あんた……何だか知らないけど!

key: You caused quite a ruckus at my--
en: You caused quite a ruckus at my--
ja: あたしの――で、とんでもない大騒ぎを起こしてくれたわね

key: Hey, get back here; I was trying to chastise you!!!
en: Hey, get back here; I was trying to chastise you!!!
ja: ちょっと、戻ってきなさいよ、まだお説教の途中なんだから!!!

key: Huh?
en: Huh?
ja: え?

key: RINGMASTER: Uh, hi, \PN!
en: RINGMASTER: Uh, hi, \PN!
ja: リングマスター: あ、どうも、\PN!

key: How long have you been there?
en: How long have you been there?
ja: いつからそこにいたの?

key: Heard you fell out of the world or something...
en: Heard you fell out of the world or something...
ja: 世界から落っこちたとかなんとか、聞いたけど……

key: Uhhh, well, no, this is great! I could use your help!
en: Uhhh, well, no, this is great! I could use your help!
ja: ええと、まあ、いいわ、ちょうどよかった! 手伝ってほしいことがあるの!

key: You see, people at my circus keep seeing this thing running around Route 3, and if it's not "Oh no, what's that?!" then it's "Come on, let's go find it!"
en: You see, people at my circus keep seeing this thing running around Route 3, and if it's not "Oh no, what's that?!" then it's "Come on, let's go find it!"
ja: あたしのサーカスの人たちが、3番道路をこいつが走り回ってるのをずっと見かけてて、「うわ、何あれ!?」ってならなきゃ「行こう、探しに行こう!」ってなるのよ。

key: It's just horrible for business!
en: It's just horrible for business!
ja: 商売に本当に響くの!

key: So I decided I'd put a stop to it myself!
en: So I decided I'd put a stop to it myself!
ja: だから、あたし自身で片づけようって決めたわけ!

key: But as you can see it's just been giving me the run-around...
en: But as you can see it's just been giving me the run-around...
ja: でも見ての通り、ずっと振り回されてるだけなのよね……

key: Dad would be so disappointed if he saw me flailing about like this...
en: Dad would be so disappointed if he saw me flailing about like this...
ja: こんな風にジタバタしてるとこ見られたら、お父さんはがっかりするでしょうね……

key: He always--
en: He always--
ja: いつもお父さんは――

key: RINGMASTER: Um?!
en: RINGMASTER: Um?!
ja: リングマスター: え?!

key: RINGMASTER: Did that Pokémon just poof into existence right in front of us?!
en: RINGMASTER: Did that Pokémon just poof into existence right in front of us?!
ja: リングマスター: 今、あのポケモン、目の前でいきなり現れなかった?!

key: Uh-- okay, change of plans!
en: Uh-- okay, change of plans!
ja: えっと――よし、予定変更!

key: I'll keep chasing the first Pokémon; you deal with that one!
en: I'll keep chasing the first Pokémon; you deal with that one!
ja: 最初のポケモンはあたしが追い続けるから、そっちはあんたに任せた!

key: I came here to have less problems, not more!
en: I came here to have less problems, not more!
ja: 問題を減らしにきたのに、増えてくじゃない!

key: RINGMASTER: We got them!
en: RINGMASTER: We got them!
ja: リングマスター: 捕まえた!

key: All right, now's our chance!
en: All right, now's our chance!
ja: よし、今がチャンスよ!

key: RINGMASTER: Wait, another one?!
en: RINGMASTER: Wait, another one?!
ja: リングマスター: え、まだいるの?!

key: RINGMASTER: Oh no, they look ready to fight!
en: RINGMASTER: Oh no, they look ready to fight!
ja: リングマスター: まずい、戦う気満々じゃない!

key: Waitwaitwait, hold on, let's talk about this!!!
en: Waitwaitwait, hold on, let's talk about this!!!
ja: 待って待って待って、ちょっと、話し合いましょう!!!

key: Ziah--
en: Ziah--
ja: ジア――

key: Kou...
en: Kou...
ja: コウ……

key: RINGMASTER: Are you kidding me?!
en: RINGMASTER: Are you kidding me?!
ja: リングマスター: 冗談でしょ?!

key: All that and they still get away?!
en: All that and they still get away?!
ja: あれだけやって、それでも逃げられるの?!

key: AND one's back in the outside world?!
en: AND one's back in the outside world?!
ja: しかも一匹は外の世界に戻っちゃったし?!

key: What even was the point?
en: What even was the point?
ja: 一体何のためだったのよ?

key: And why is it always something?
en: And why is it always something?
ja: どうしていつも何か起きるの?

key: Maybe it's time to throw in the hat.
en: Maybe it's time to throw in the hat.
ja: もうシルクハットを投げ出す時かもね。

key: You know, I try to make him proud-- I really do.
en: You know, I try to make him proud-- I really do.
ja: ねえ、お父さんに誇りに思ってもらおうと頑張ってるのよ――本当に。

key: I just--
en: I just--
ja: ただ――

key: I didn't ask for this.
en: I didn't ask for this.
ja: こんなこと、望んでなかったのに。

key: I like performing!
en: I like performing!
ja: ショーをするのは好きなの!

key: I like putting on a show-- I was practically raised in center stage!
en: I like putting on a show-- I was practically raised in center stage!
ja: 舞台に立つのが好き――ほとんどセンターステージで育ったようなものなんだから!

key: So when Dad died, I thought, "Sure, I can take over. I can handle this."
en: So when Dad died, I thought, "Sure, I can take over. I can handle this."
ja: だからお父さんが死んだ時、「大丈夫、あたしが引き継げる。やれる」って思ったの。

key: Turns out being a performer is the easy part.
en: Turns out being a performer is the easy part.
ja: 結局、演者でいることの方が簡単だったのよね。

key: But trying to manage employees and customers and the business-- Ugh.
en: But trying to manage employees and customers and the business-- Ugh.
ja: でも従業員やお客さん、経営を回すとなると――もう、うんざり。

key: I could use a break.
en: I could use a break.
ja: 休みが欲しいわ。

key: Like don't get me wrong, I would love to have a word with whoever's behind all these Pokémon popping up!
en: Like don't get me wrong, I would love to have a word with whoever's behind all these Pokémon popping up!
ja: 誤解しないでね、こんな風にポケモンが次々現れてる元凶には、ぜひ一言言ってやりたいの!

key: And that word is "STOP."
en: And that word is "STOP."
ja: その一言は「やめて」ね。

key: But I don't think I'm cut out for the actual act of wrangling them.
en: But I don't think I'm cut out for the actual act of wrangling them.
ja: でも、実際にこいつらを取り押さえるのは、あたしには向いてない気がする。

key: That's Champion stuff, right?
en: That's Champion stuff, right?
ja: それってチャンピオンの仕事でしょ?

key: Gym Leader stuff at the least.
en: Gym Leader stuff at the least.
ja: 少なくともジムリーダーの仕事よね。

key: I should've had Samson do it.
en: I should've had Samson do it.
ja: サムソンにやらせるべきだったわ。

key: But he's--
en: But he's--
ja: でも彼は――

key: Ugh...
en: Ugh...
ja: うぐ……

key: Um, hey...
en: Um, hey...
ja: ええと、あのさ……

key: I really don't like to quit halfway through a show, but can I leave this to you?
en: I really don't like to quit halfway through a show, but can I leave this to you?
ja: ショーを途中で投げ出すのは本当に嫌なんだけど、これ、あんたに任せてもいい?

key: Hey, listen, I really don't like to quit halfway through a show, but can I leave this to you?
en: Hey, listen, I really don't like to quit halfway through a show, but can I leave this to you?
ja: ねえ聞いて、ショーを途中で投げ出すのは本当に嫌なんだけど、これ、あんたに任せてもいい?

key: Those two should be here somewhere, and the third probably hasn't even made it out of Route 3...
en: Those two should be here somewhere, and the third probably hasn't even made it out of Route 3...
ja: あの二匹はこの辺のどこかにいるはずで、三匹目はたぶん3番道路からまだ出てもいないと思うんだけど……

key: But I think I need a moment.
en: But I think I need a moment.
ja: でも、ちょっと一息つく時間が必要みたい。

key: Come find me after you deal with them, okay?
en: Come find me after you deal with them, okay?
ja: 片づけたら、あたしを見つけに来てね?

key: I'd-- appreciate it.
en: I'd-- appreciate it.
ja: その――助かるわ。

key: RINGMASTER: What a disaster.
en: RINGMASTER: What a disaster.
ja: リングマスター: とんだ災難だったわ。

key: I mean truthfully I was hoping to catch one of these things myself and add it to the show, but after all this, I'm feeling pretty over it.
en: I mean truthfully I was hoping to catch one of these things myself and add it to the show, but after all this, I'm feeling pretty over it.
ja: 正直、自分でこいつらの一匹を捕まえてショーに加えたいと思ってたんだけど、こんなことになったら、もういいやって気分。

key: Feeling pretty over a lot of things right now.
en: Feeling pretty over a lot of things right now.
ja: 今は色んなことに、もういいやって思ってるところ。

key: RINGMASTER: So you got them all, huh?
en: RINGMASTER: So you got them all, huh?
ja: リングマスター: それで、全部捕まえたのね?

key: Thanks for bailing me out.
en: Thanks for bailing me out.
ja: 助けてくれてありがとう。

key: I guess that's the show then. Let's head on back.
en: I guess that's the show then. Let's head on back.
ja: じゃあ、これでショーは終わりね。戻りましょ。

key: RINGMASTER: I'm gonna turn around and there's gonna be more nonsense behind me, huh.
en: RINGMASTER: I'm gonna turn around and there's gonna be more nonsense behind me, huh.
ja: リングマスター: 振り向いたら、また何かとんでもないことが起きてるんでしょ、どうせ。

key: RINGMASTER: Great galloping Galvantula, whaddyaknow.
en: RINGMASTER: Great galloping Galvantula, whaddyaknow.
ja: リングマスター: なんてこと、デンチュラも真っ青ね、驚いた。

key: Well, ladies and gentlemen, let's see what's behind door number three.
en: Well, ladies and gentlemen, let's see what's behind door number three.
ja: さて、紳士淑女の皆さま、三番目の扉の向こうを見てみましょうか。

key: COBALION: Kou! Ba!
en: COBALION: Kou! Ba!
ja: コバルオン: コウ! バ!

key: VIRIZION: Viri?!
en: VIRIZION: Viri?!
ja: ビリジオン: ビリ?!
